note: 16:9 film. The script asks for the hook text, one lower third, one list card, one statement card, one top text and the end card, so 5 graphics and the end card. The page draws one logo on the end card: add the BUILD logo next to the NFTE logo in your edit.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: “School is missing a subject.” Already on screen at 0:00. It does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:04. Over the classroom shot.

mg.title: Lower third
mg.cue: Lower third at 00:17 for 3 s, on his first on-camera line: “J.D. LaRock” / CEO, NFTE.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:17 for 3 s, lower left above the captions. Type the second line CEO, NFTE under it.

mg.title: Skills list
mg.cue: List card, full frame, about 00:38 to 00:43: “The ability to” · “work in teams” · “solve problems” · “spot opportunities” · “think about the future”.
mg.use: Full-frame cutaway from about 00:38 to 00:43 while he lists the skills. His voice keeps playing. Slide it so each item lands on his words.

mg.title: Statement card
mg.cue: Statement card, full frame, 00:55 to 00:58: “Entrepreneurship produces economic mobility.”
mg.use: Full-frame cutaway 00:55 to 00:58 while he says it. Then B-roll.

mg.title: Top text

text.main: Right now we need to be doing more

mg.cue: Top text as he says it: “Right now we need to be doing more”. 2.5 s.
mg.use: Put it on at 01:31 as he says it and hold 2.5 s. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: the words Fuel a Future, the NFTE logo and the BUILD logo, and nfte.com/fuelafuture.
